stem: The U.S. foreign policy illustrated in this cartoon was intended to —

options.label: F
options.text: prevent further European colonization in the Western Hemisphere

options.label: G
options.text: deter Spain from inciting revolution in former U.S. colonies

options.label: H
options.text: encourage European powers to invest in Latin America

options.label: J
options.text: keep the war between France and Spain from spreading to Latin America

visual_elements: political cartoon titled 'His Foresight' showing a large rooster labeled 'U.S.' confronting other smaller roosters, with a sign reading 'MONROE DOCTRINE' and dialogue 'Europe: You're not the only rooster in South America! Uncle Sam: I was aware of that when I cooped you up!'
